title: Micchattasuttaṃ
text: 21 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Micchattañca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, sammattañca. Taṃ suṇātha. Katamañca , bhikkhave, micchattaṃ? Seyyathidaṃ – micchādiṭṭhi…pe… micchāsamādhi . Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, micchattaṃ. Katamañca, bhikkhave, sammattaṃ? Seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi…pe… sammāsamādhi. Idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammatta’’nti. Paṭhamaṃ.
